entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A system that organizes retrieved information into a graph structure and transforms it into a sequence for LLMs.

entities.name: Lossless Compression of Retrieved Context
entities.description: A technique to remove redundant information and compress lengthy sentences into shorter, meaningful ones to handle long contexts in GraphRAG.

relationships.description: Lossless compression is a technique applied within the GraphRAG workflow to manage long contexts.
